title: Market VS Trader 🥊 #crypto #stockmarket #trading #memes #brainrot
hook: no speech; instant conflict with two labels (MARKET vs TRADER)
visual: animated cartoon character brawl, new expression/pose every ~2s, red loss counter and ACCOUNT LIQUIDATED overlay
captions: none, only big label text and overlays
audio: impact sounds and grunts, no music/voice
why: relatable pain + extreme brevity (12s) loops; reach driven by an existing meme brand
avoid: channel promotes a memecoin; brand IP character

title: The Power of Compound Interest | Become a Millionaire #compoundinterest #investing
hook: bold claim that an average person can reach a big number via compounding (we cannot use the claim)
visual: black background, glowing ball rolling along a line, big YEAR n and dollar counter ticking up, assumption chips (start, rate, yearly deposit) at top
captions: none burned in; numbers carry the video
why: single analogy + continuous counter progression, minimalist and premium looking

title: 3 financial literacy tips #shorts
hook: numbered list title card: 3 tips, first tip starts at 0s
visual: real expert talking head, lower-third name/role, one B-roll cutaway, publisher logo
captions: word-by-word, 2-3 words in a dark pill, active phrase highlighted
why: credible named expert + numbered structure; backed by a large news brand
avoid: needs licensed real footage; cannot be automated

title: $1 to $100 Billion 💸💰#shorts #money #finance #usa
hook: escalating price ladder: every beat is the same sentence with a bigger amount
visual: stick figure with a prop per price, big green price label, new item every ~2s, plain pastel background
captions: none, the price label is the caption
audio: fast neutral voice, single sentence pattern
why: predictable escalation keeps people to the end; very cheap to produce
avoid: celebrity face cutouts and team logo used as props (likeness/IP)

title: The one money mistake everyone laughs at 😂 #finance #shorts
hook: I have something to tell you + surprising money fact
visual: flat cartoon illustrations, one new scene every ~5s, recurring character, many bank/gold props
captions: small uppercase white lower-third, a few words at a time
audio: background music plus sound effects (cash register, chime, clink, pain exclamation)
why: fact-after-fact structure with a physical-pain analogy and a comment prompt at the end
avoid: several unsourced money claims; 308 views so far (new upload), weak evidence it works
